selected_records.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot

article.body:
Autonomous-Vehicle Bulletin:

No AV Deployment Evidence from AI Time-Horizon Paper

A recently published paper titled "On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons—a statistical look at the METR plot," available on arXiv, does not provide evidence of an autonomous-vehicle (AV) test or service. The paper does not identify a specific vehicle, autonomy stack, operational domain, safety data, deployment, or regulatory approval.

The paper, dated 8 October 2026, focuses on the estimation and validity of AI time horizons, but does not discuss any AV deployment or real-world testing. As such, it does not provide evidence of an AV test or service.

For more information on AV developments, stay tuned to Machina Daily.
